wordingRefinement.oldA46Text: Hallowed ground protects a permanent grove from disease and natural disaster; cast out makes natural creatures react negatively.
wordingRefinement.proposedText: Hallowed ground protects a druid’s permanent grove from disease and other natural disasters for as long as the druid maintains it as a permanent base.
wordingRefinement.sourceReading: The rite is cast on the permanent grove and specifically ensorcels its trees against disease and other natural disasters; the ground remains hallowed while the druid maintains the grove as a permanent base.
wordingRefinement.recommendedWording: Hallowed ground is cast on the druid’s permanent grove, ensorcelling its trees against disease and other natural disasters. The ground remains hallowed while the druid maintains that grove as a permanent base.
wordingRefinement.reason: The proposal's phrase 'protects a druid’s permanent grove' can imply that the entire grove is protected; the source identifies the trees as the protected subjects and separately says the ground remains hallowed.
